description: AMPS traces individual particle trajectories through outputs from previously completed magnetosphere simulations. The documented tool estimates particle positions and velocities within those prescribed fields. The resource is documented by UMICH/CSEM. The documented physical domain is Geospace, Magnetosphere / Global Magnetosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. It depends on the parent simulation's output cadence and treatment of electric fields. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
